title: Middle East tensions escalate as missile strikes disrupt oil shipping through Strait of Hormuz
snippet: Crude oil prices surged by 7% following reports of attacks on two commercial tankers in international waters, prompting warnings of supply chain embargoes.

title: Federal Reserve Chair hints at surprise 50 basis point rate hike as core inflation remains persistent
snippet: Policymakers express concern over wage growth and commodity price spikes, indicating monetary tightening will continue through year-end.

title: Major global conglomerate defaults on $3.2B senior unsecured debt following audit crisis

title: Tech giants announce landmark $25B cloud merger to expand enterprise artificial intelligence capabilities
snippet: The combined entity will streamline data center operations and cross-sell SaaS productivity suites across international markets.

title: European Union antitrust regulators initiate formal antitrust inquiry into digital advertising monopoly
snippet: Regulators warn of fines up to 10% of annual worldwide revenue if anticompetitive self-preferencing practices continue.
